scope: Style frames for the cash-furnace sequence (3:30-4:14) — approval stills for the upgraded art direction

beat.narration: Investors poured billions into internet companies...

shots.understanding: Investor money flows from the venture firm across the street into a dot-com that is spending it loudly; the market is euphoric.
shots.focal_point: BigCart building and its rooftop billboard (left third), with the capital pipe running from Summit Ventures into it
shots.camera: low eye-level, two-point perspective down the street; in motion: slow push-in along the pipe (mCamera / keyCam)
shots.lighting: dusk sun low at the end of the street (warm key), lamp pools, lit windows; fog for depth; vignette + grain

graphics.what: TECH STOCKS market board at the street's end (rising line)
graphics.why: market euphoria shown in the world

graphics.what: capital pipe with valve from the VC tower into BigCart
graphics.why: the money flow is physical and continuous

graphics.what: cash tank visible through the lobby window
graphics.why: the company's balance is an object

shots.rationale: An establishing shot must place the viewer in the era and show the relationship (VC -> startup) before any detail. Real perspective, texture and dusk light replace the flat isometric diorama the audit rejected; the money is plumbing, not a dashboard.

beat.narration: ...spending heavily on advertising, employees and infrastructure...

shots.understanding: Spending on ads, staff and servers dwarfs revenue; the gap is filled with investor cash — and the team can see it.
shots.focal_point: the manager pointing at the easel whiteboard burn chart (right half); worried staff react on the left
shots.camera: eye level, slight angle; in motion: settle-in dolly with the bars drawn on in sync with 'advertising / employees / infrastructure' (mDrawOn, mWordsAt)
shots.lighting: interior panel lights + warm dusk window light from the left, soft cast shadows, mild fog to separate the back wall

graphics.what: marker bar chart on an easel whiteboard (ADS / STAFF / SERVERS vs REVENUE)
graphics.why: a character explains the gap inside the story

graphics.what: CRT showing a falling cash balance
hiring banner, Super Bowl ad poster, framed funding clipping, cash gauge on the brass riser
graphics.why: each spending category is set dressing

shots.rationale: A medium shot lets the viewer read both the explanation and the human reaction. The chart is drawn by a character on an object, satisfying the 'no floating dashboards' rule while staying legible.

shots.understanding: The consequence is personal: the founder, alone at night, sees the cash run out while trying to raise more.
shots.focal_point: the founder's worried face (left-centre), eyes toward the CRT
shots.camera: locked off — stillness sells the dread; in motion only a slow 2% push and the curve finishing its fall (mDrawOn)
shots.lighting: red CRT key from screen-right with rim light, cool blue ambient fill, out-of-focus night office and city bokeh

graphics.what: CASH BALANCE curve and RUNWAY LEFT on the CRT
graphics.why: the data is the light source on his face

graphics.what: term sheet and calculator (-4.2M) on the desk

shots.rationale: Shot variety (establishing -> medium -> close-up) and an emotional beat. The close-up rig draws a modelled three-quarter face with expression, stubble and a real hand on the phone, instead of scaling up a full-body figure.
